msg: The most important thing is not to be distracted but really focus on the task.If you flag and become too slow then you lose your momentum.I also think that it is very important to be quick to press the space bar after choosing your gnome as my higher scores of 8 or 9 were when I was quicker.I also found it easier to keep to s for a while and then k for a while.I'm not convinced that the colours were relevant although I may be wrong.Good luck!
